description: Agent matrix for remote E2E. Cursor ensure stages install.sh+lib.sh+cursor.sh in ~/.cache (jsDelivr + raw fallback) then bash ./install.sh stable --extract. Qoder -q -p needs QODER_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN — set E2E_QODER_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN locally.

agents.name: Codex CLI
agents.notes: OpenAI Codex CLI; hooks installed by loongsuite-pilot installer.
agents.ensureInstallSh: npm install -g @openai/codex || echo '[e2e-ensure] npm install @openai/codex failed'
agents.defaultProbeSh: command -v codex >/dev/null && codex exec "你好" --skip-git-repo-check < /dev/null || true
agents.installHint: Use E2E_USE_MATRIX_PROBE=1; codex exec must use < /dev/null.

agents.name: Claude Code
agents.ensureInstallSh: npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code || echo '[e2e-ensure] npm install claude-code failed'
agents.installHint: claude -p needs login or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; expect Not logged in until configured.

agents.name: Cursor
agents.notes: ensureInstallSh is generated in code (jsDelivr+raw GitHub, --extract). Primary SLS is often cursor-hook from IDE, not CLI --version.
agents.defaultProbeSh: _CX="$HOME/.local/share/cursor/cursor/usr/bin/cursor"; _CX2="$HOME/.cursor/cursor/usr/bin/cursor"; if command -v cursor >/dev/null 2>&1; then cursor --version 2>&1 || true; elif [ -x "$_CX" ]; then "$_CX" --version 2>&1 || true; elif [ -x "$_CX2" ]; then "$_CX2" --version 2>&1 || true; elif command -v cursor-installer >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "[e2e-probe] no cursor on PATH or extracted usr/bin; cursor-installer:"; cursor-installer --version 2>/dev/null || true; else echo "[e2e-probe] neither cursor nor cursor-installer on PATH"; fi

agents.name: Qoder CLI
agents.notes: Hook input watches ~/.loongsuite-pilot/logs/qoder-cli/history; qoder-cli-session reads ~/.qoder/logs/sessions. Print probe uses qodercli -q -p (needs token).
agents.ensureInstallSh: npm install -g @qoder-ai/qodercli && mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin" && ( command -v qoder >/dev/null || ( command -v qodercli >/dev/null && ln -sf "$(command -v qodercli)" "$HOME/.local/bin/qoder" ) ) || echo '[e2e-ensure] qoder npm/symlink failed'
agents.defaultProbeSh: Q="$(command -v qodercli 2>/dev/null || command -v qoder 2>/dev/null)"; [ -z "$Q" ] && exit 0; mkdir -p "$HOME/.qoder"; if [ -z "${QODER_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN:-}" ]; then echo "[e2e-probe] QODER_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN unset — set E2E_QODER_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN on **local** npm env to inject for qodercli -p"; exit 0; fi; "$Q" -q -p "你好" --max-turns 1 --yolo -w "$HOME" </dev/null || true
agents.installHint: Logstore needs a real model turn; --version alone emits nothing. Use PAT via E2E_QODER_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN.
